Old (v1): Use digitizing software to convert artwork into a stitch file.
New: Prepare artwork and a complete order for outsourced digitizing, then verify the returned stitch file before it goes into production.

Old (v1): Open artwork and set correct canvas size in digitizing software
New: Specify final stitch size and placement on the digitizing order

Old (v1): Assign correct stitch types to each element
New: Note garment, fabric and fine details so the digitizer can set stitch types
Flag blending, density or direction needs on the order
Define thread colors (Madeira numbers) and sewing order

Old (v1): Export stitch file in correct format for machine
New: Verify the returned stitch file matches the order and is in the correct format (DST)

Old (v1): Verify image is mirrored correctly for emulsion-side down
New: Verify the positive reads correctly on the garment and explain why it reads mirrored on the print side of the screen

Old (v1): Position film on screen emulsion-side down
New: Attach the positive to the print side of the screen in print position
Select the correct import profile for the garment (for example Dark-Garment)

Old (v1): Configure print resolution and pass count
New: Verify the print resolution, pass count and white layer set by the import profile
Remove tape and recover leftover ink
Strip ink and emulsion in the EasiStrip Supra dip tank
Pressure wash and clear leftover emulsion or plastisol (701N) and stuck paint (C99)
Dehaze with 415N when needed, wearing a full respirator
Clean the press, squeegees and floodbars and return chemicals to storage
